name: Houston Scissor & Boom Lifts Q4
brief: We sell scissor and boom lifts. Find companies in the Houston area that do a lot of overhead work: big warehouses, manufacturers with high-bay facilities, electrical, HVAC and sign contractors. Prefer 20+ employees. Growing companies are best. Skip rental companies and our existing customers.

segments.name: Warehousing & 3PL
segments.rationale: High-bay racking, lighting and maintenance work at height.

segments.name: High-bay manufacturing
segments.rationale: Plant maintenance, crane and lighting access.

segments.name: Electrical, HVAC & sign contractors
segments.rationale: Daily installation work at height on commercial jobs.

segments.name: Facilities & property management
segments.rationale: Atriums, lobbies and campus lighting maintenance.
